import argparse

def cmd_run_a(args):
    print('running run_a', args.target)

def cmd_run_b(args):
    print('running run_b', args.target)

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='my_tool')
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)
    a = sub.add_parser('run_a'); a.add_argument('target'); a.set_defaults(func=cmd_run_a)
    b = sub.add_parser('run_b'); b.add_argument('target'); b.set_defaults(func=cmd_run_b)
    args = p.parse_args()
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import yaml
from pathlib import Path

def deep_merge(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        out = dict(a)
        for k, v in b.items():
            out[k] = deep_merge(a.get(k), v) if k in a else v
        return out
    return b

base = yaml.safe_load(Path('path/to/base/deployment.yaml').read_text())
over = yaml.safe_load(Path('path/to/override/deployment.yaml').read_text())
merged = deep_merge(base, over)
Path('path/to/merged/deployment.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(merged, sort_keys=False))
print('merged -> path/to/merged/deployment.yaml')
